descriptions.job-0w83z2b:
About Riot Platforms

Riot’s (NASDAQ: RIOT) vision is to be the world’s most trusted platform for powering and building digital infrastructure. Riot’s mission is to empower the future of digital infrastructure by positively impacting the sectors, networks, and communities that we touch. We believe that the combination of an innovative spirit and strong community partnership allows us to achieve best-in-class execution and create successful outcomes.

Who we are

At Riot, we’re building the future of digital infrastructure. Our team members have unparalleled opportunities to work on groundbreaking initiatives. Through technical excellence and strategic execution, Riot has positioned itself as a leader in the industry driving advancements that continue to set new benchmarks in digital infrastructure. 

We are trailblazers. Problem solvers. People who thrive in fast paced environments, communicate clearly, and bring relentless focus to efficiency and execution.   

About the role

We are looking to add a Security Shift Supervisor to our growing Security Department. At Riot Platforms, maintaining a safe and secure workplace is a top priority. Our Security team serves as the first line of defense, helping protect our employees, visitors, vendors, and company assets. In this role, you will help maintain a secure environment by promoting safe behaviors, controlling access, maintaining order, enforcing rules and regulations, and working collaboratively with others to address security concerns.

As a Security Shift Supervisor, you will oversee security team members and daily security operations while working closely with Assistant Supervisors and Security Officers. You will help resolve disputes, ensure Officers remain current on required training, maintain operational readiness, and support the Site Security Manager with the day-to-day needs of the security operation. This role is ideal for an experienced security professional who understands the demands of security operations and is ready to take on a leadership role.

What you'll be doing

  • Plan, schedule, organize, and direct the daily activities of the security team.
  • Develop and maintain effective working relationships with security personnel, visitors, vendors, employees, and customers.
  • Monitor security operations and team performance, providing guidance and training to ensure professional and appropriate interactions.
  • Address customer service inquiries and security-related concerns in a timely and professional manner.
  • Ensure CCTV systems effectively monitor designated areas in compliance with applicable laws, regulations, and company policies.
  • Conduct vehicle and foot patrols of the property, including grounds, parking areas, perimeters, entrances, exits, doors, gates, and secured areas, to identify security concerns and ensure facilities are properly secured.
  • Manage access control by greeting visitors, vendors, and employees at entry gates, verifying identification, and maintaining accurate access and visitor logs.
  • Identify, document, and report safety hazards, security breaches, suspicious activity, and other security concerns.
  • Respond promptly to emergencies, alarms, and incidents, coordinating with law enforcement, fire, EMS, and other emergency personnel as needed.
  • Conduct shift briefings and ensure accurate communication and information handoffs between shifts.
  • Administer discipline and corrective action for security team members in accordance with company policy, documenting performance concerns and coordinating with the Site Security Manager and Human Resources as needed.
  • Serve as a peer advocate and representative for security officers in disciplinary or remediation settings when requested.
  • Interview, onboard, and train new security team members, helping ensure new hires are prepared to effectively perform their duties.

What you'll have

  • Must hold a DPS Level II license upon hire and obtain a Level III license within 30 days of hire.
  • Bachelor's degree, or 5 years' experience in management, law enforcement, security, and/or military.
  • Must hold a valid driver’s license and pass a Motor Vehicle Record (MVR) check.
  • Must maintain a high level of weapons proficiency.
  • Certified in CPR/AED/First Aid.
  • Speaks, reads, and writes English and communicates clearly and congenially with guests, visitors, and employees. Bilingual skills are helpful but not required.
  • Strong oral and written communication skills, including report writing, with the ability to teach and mentor.
  • Ability to lead a team.
  • Ability to evaluate and select among alternative courses of action quickly and accurately.
  • Effective at handling workplace problems, including anticipating, preventing, identifying, and solving problems as necessary.
  • Ability to think clearly, analyze situations, and resolve problems using good judgment.
  • Tactical and operational knowledge of responding to incidents.
  • Excellent surveillance and observation skills.
  • Tech-savvy, with experience in surveillance systems.
  • Proficiency in self-defense techniques.
  • Must maintain a high standard of personal appearance and grooming, including wearing the proper uniform.
  • Must wear a bulletproof (ballistic) vest as part of the required uniform and equipment. (provided by company)
  • Must maintain the highest level of professionalism, accountability, attention to detail, sense of urgency, and transparency.
  • Works varying hours and schedules, including holidays, evenings, and weekends.

Physical requirements and work environment

  • Must be physically able to climb ladders and access tight or awkward spaces as required.
  • Must be able to bend, reach, stoop, and pull, with good manual dexterity.
  • Ability to stand, walk, and perform repetitive tasks for extended periods
  • Ability to lift and move equipment as needed (75 Pounds)
  • Ability to work onsite in a mining or data center environment (heat, noise, etc.)
  • Exposure to high noise levels and varying temperatures

Safety Requirements

  • PPE & Compliance: Strictly adhere to all site safety protocols and wear required Personal Protective Equipment (PPE) at all times (e.g., safety glasses, hearing protection, steel-toed boots).
  • Hazard Awareness: Proactively identify, report, and mitigate potential workplace hazards or unsafe conditions.
  • Standards: Maintain compliance with OSHA regulations and internal safety training.
  • Organization: Keep all work areas clean and free of obstructions to prevent workplace accidents.

Compensation and Benefits 

  • Salary commensurate with experience. 
  • 401(k) retirement plan: Incudes a generous company match.
  • Comprehensive health coverage: Multiple medical plan options, including 100% company-paid plans, HAS & FSA.
  • Work-life balance: Paid time off, sick time and floating holidays.
  • Wellness & lifestyle perks: Enjoy free gym memberships, pet insurance, childcare discounts, employee assistance program, and more to support your life both in and out of work.

Riot is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.
descriptions.job-1uk58xv:
The Role

We are looking for a Technical Support Analyst to join our Cluj team as the third analyst covering the Americas, strengthening our US presence and ensuring our customers there receive fast, expert, and genuinely helpful support inside their own working day.

This is an L1 role with a real technical centre of gravity. You will be the first point of contact for our customers, handling inbound support requests across our product suite, and you will be expected to get to the actual cause of an issue rather than pass it on — reading API responses, working through client integration problems, and understanding what a script is doing when it stops behaving as expected. You will escalate thoughtfully where an issue genuinely needs another team, working closely with our internal teams, including Data, Implementation, and Engineering. and with Customer Success so that no customer is left waiting and no issue falls through the gap.

We are a fintech company on a mission to fight financial crime. Our platform uses AI, machine learning, and big data to help compliance teams at over 3000 customers across 75+ countries work faster and more accurately. The problems our customers bring to support are real, operational, and often time-sensitive — and how quickly and how well we respond has a direct impact on their day-to-day operations. Support is not a back-office function: it is a critical touchpoint that connects our customers to our Data, Research, Business Information, Product, and Engineering teams. Speed of response and quality of resolution are both non-negotiable.

Two things about this role we would rather you know now than discover later. First, the hours: this is a night shift, 17:00 to 02:00 (1 hour break Included) Romanian time, because that is when our US customers are working. Second, the autonomy: for most of your shift you will be the technical presence on duty, without a manager online. That suits someone who would rather own a decision than wait for one — and it is the single most important thing we will be assessing.


What You Will Be Doing

Technical Troubleshooting & Root Cause

  • Investigate customer issues at API level: read requests and responses, interpret status codes and error payloads, check authentication and rate limits, and establish where a failure actually originates.
  • Work through client integration problems and identify the root cause, rather than reproducing the symptom and routing it onward.
  • Read, understand, and diagnose Python scripts — including scripts generated with AI assistance — when they stop doing what they are supposed to. You do not need to write code from scratch; you do need to be able to work out what code is doing and where it is going wrong.
  • Query and inspect data directly where that is what it takes to answer the question.
  • Know when an issue genuinely belongs with another team, and hand it over with everything they need.

Customer Support & Ticket Management

  • Serve as the first point of contact for inbound support requests from ComplyAdvantage customers across the Americas, primarily via our ticketing platform and email.
  • Triage all incoming tickets accurately and promptly: assess the nature of each request, categorise it correctly, and either take ownership and respond directly, or route to the relevant internal team — Data, Research, Business Information, Customer Success, Implementation, Product, Engineering, or L2 — with clear context and correct prioritisation.
  • Resolve L1 issues independently to a high standard, with a strong first-contact resolution rate as a personal benchmark.
  • Prioritise a busy queue sensibly: understand which customers and which issues need attention first, and act on that rather than working strictly first-in-first-out.
  • Keep customers informed at every stage — proactive updates, not radio silence. If something is taking longer than expected, the customer should hear from you before they chase.
  • Follow up on resolved tickets to confirm the customer is satisfied and the issue has not recurred.
  • Flag proactively when your queue is at risk of breaching SLAs, rather than waiting for a breach to happen.

Incident Response & On-Call

  • Take on responsibility for urgent queries and outages arriving through incident.io during your shift. We will get you set up on it early and train you into it.
  • Join the on-call rotation for your region at around six months — a rotation of three, so roughly one week on and two weeks off. This sits inside your existing shift and does not change your hours.
  • Extend to the weekend rotation at around twelve months, or earlier if you are ready.
  • Contribute to runbooks and escalation procedures so that the next person on duty has what you wish you had had.

Product Knowledge & Customer Education

  • Develop and maintain a deep, working knowledge of the ComplyAdvantage product suite, including how customers use the platform to manage compliance and financial crime risk.
  • Proactively identify opportunities to educate customers on product features, best practices, and self-serve resources that will reduce future friction.
  • Contribute to and maintain the team knowledge base: when you resolve an issue that is not yet documented, write it up. A well-maintained KB reduces repeat tickets for everyone.
  • Stay current with product updates, new features, and known issues so that your support is always accurate and up to date.

Quality & Continuous Improvement

  • Take personal ownership of your performance against our key metrics: first response time, resolution time, and internal quality score — which is largely about categorising tickets correctly. These are not just team targets; they reflect the quality of your individual work and are reviewed regularly.
  • Take ownership of the quality of your own work: re-read your responses before sending, check that the solution actually addresses the customer's problem, and never send a holding response when a substantive one is possible.
  • Participate actively in team QA processes: review flagged tickets with an open mind, apply feedback, and share learnings with colleagues.
  • Identify recurring issues or patterns in your ticket queue and surface them to your manager and the L2 team — support insight should drive product and process improvement.
  • Contribute to the continuous improvement of L1 playbooks, response templates, and escalation procedures.
  • Engage with AI tools and workflow automation as they are introduced — we use them to draft and adapt scripts and to help sharpen customer communication. Look for ways to work smarter and handle volume without sacrificing quality.

Information Security & Data Handling

Our customers are highly regulated financial institutions. The data we handle is sensitive, and the consequences of a data breach — for our customers and for ComplyAdvantage — are serious. Information security is not a background consideration; it is a core part of how this role is performed.

  • Handle all customer data, including PII, with the highest level of care. Never share, expose, or transmit customer data outside of approved channels and processes.
  • Follow ComplyAdvantage data handling policies and information security best practices at all times — in ticket responses, in internal communications, and in how you use and store information.
  • Apply meticulous attention to detail when drafting responses: check that you are replying to the right customer, referencing the right account, and sharing only information the recipient is authorised to receive.
  • Escalate any suspected data breach, accidental disclosure, or security concern immediately and without hesitation — speed of reporting matters.
  • Complete all mandatory information security training and stay current with policy updates as they are issued.

Cross-functional Collaboration

  • Work closely and continuously with our Customer Success Managers. On this shift they are your most frequent partners — flagging at-risk customers, recurring pain points, and opportunities to improve the customer experience.
  • Collaborate with Data, Research, Business Information, Implementation, Product, and Engineering to ensure smooth escalation, resolution, and feedback loops.
  • Share customer feedback and product issues with Product and Engineering through the appropriate channels, with enough context to be actionable.
  • Hand over cleanly at the end of your shift, and coordinate with the wider support team across regions so coverage and service quality stay consistent.


About You:

Experience

  • A technical background. A degree in Computer Science or a comparable technical field is preferred — but around three years of hands-on work as a technical support analyst is an equally good answer, and coding or technical certifications count too.
  • 2–4 years in a customer-facing technical support or helpdesk role, ideally in a B2B SaaS environment, with real depth rather than volume alone.
  • Demonstrable experience troubleshooting at API level: you can read REST API documentation, interpret an error response, and reason about why a request is failing.
  • Able to read Python and work out what a script is doing, including finding why it has stopped working. Writing production code is not part of this role.
  • Experience using a ticketing or case management platform (Zendesk, Freshdesk, Intercom, Pylon, or similar).
  • Fluent English, written and spoken, to a professional standard.
  • Familiarity with tools such as Jira, Confluence, and GitLab is a plus.
  • Experience with incident management or handling escalations is a strong plus, as is any prior on-call experience (PagerDuty, incident.io, or similar).
  • Experience with high-tier or VIP accounts that expect immediate attention is a plus.
  • Experience in or exposure to the compliance, fintech, or financial services sector is an advantage but not required.


Skills & Mindset

  • Able to work independently. For most of your shift there is no manager online, so you need the judgement to decide what you can handle and the sense to know what genuinely needs escalating — and the discipline to hand over cleanly at the end of the night.
  • Meticulous attention to detail — you notice when something does not look right, and you do not send a response you are not confident in.
  • Strong written communication: clear, professional, empathetic, and concise. Most of our support is written by email and scheduled video calls rather than live phone queues, so writing well is the core communication skill here.
  • Genuinely customer-focused: you find it satisfying to solve someone's problem well, and you find it uncomfortable when a customer is left waiting or under-served.
  • Calm and effective under pressure: able to manage a busy queue, prioritise competing demands, and stay composed when customers are frustrated or persistent.
  • A proactive communicator — you update customers before they chase, flag issues before they escalate, and share knowledge rather than hoarding it.
  • Collaborative and low-ego: you ask for help when you need it, and you share what you know with the team.
  • Curious about technology and keen to develop your product knowledge over time.
  • Comfortable working in a distributed team across time zones, with a schedule from 5PM to 02 AM in Romania.

What We Offer

  • A genuinely important role: fighting financial crime is meaningful work, and the quality of your support directly affects our customers' ability to do it.
  • Real technical work. This is not a scripted support role — you will be expected to investigate, diagnose, and explain, and you will be given the autonomy to do it.
  • The chance to raise the bar. We are deliberately hiring for more technical depth on this shift, and what you build and document will shape how the team works.
  • A modern toolstack — Slack, Jira, Confluence, incident.io — and an environment that actively invests in AI tools to make your work smarter.
  • A clear development path: we are building a tiered support function, and strong analysts have a growth path to senior analyst, and beyond.
  • Competitive salary and benefits in line with the Romanian market.
  • A collaborative, low-ego team culture where your ideas are taken seriously and your growth is invested in.

Benefits

  • What’s in it for you?  
  • Competitive salary aligned to your skills and experience 
  • Equity as we want you to have a part of what we are building 
  • Unlimited Time Off Policy- A work-life balance and focus on our well-being are critical to keeping us performing at our best 
  • We embrace a hybrid approach that requires employees to be in the office for 1-2 days a week. We strongly believe that this approach fosters collaboration and enables the building of meaningful relationships
  • You will also get an annual budget of 1215 RON to kit out your home office 
  • Opportunity to work on innovative projects with smart-minded people keen to share their knowledge and continuously improve 
  • Annual learning budget of 10,450 RON (prorated based on start date) to drive your performance and career development 
  • Meal Vouchers 45 RON/ Day 
  • Access to an Employee Assistance Programme (Atlas) 
  • Medical Insurance 
  • 7Card Subscription (upon request)

The base salary range for this role is 83,000-104,000 RON Gross + bonus, equity and benefits. The actual pay may vary based on factors such as location, experience, and skill.

About us

Our mission is to empower every business to eliminate financial crime. 

By harnessing AI, a unified platform, and an extensive partner ecosystem, we help customers turn compliance into a catalyst for growth, operational resilience, and enduring regulatory trust.

More than 3,000 enterprises across 75 countries rely on our end-to-end platform and the world’s most comprehensive financial crime risk intelligence. With full-stack agentic automation, we help organizations automate up to 95% of KYC, AML, and sanctions reviews, cut onboarding times by 50%, reduce false positives by 70%, and handle 7x more work with the same staff.

ComplyAdvantage is headquartered in London and has global hubs in New York, Lisbon, Singapore, and Cluj-Napoca. It is backed by Balderton Capital, Index Ventures, Ontario Teachers’ Pension Plan, Goldman Sachs, and Andreessen Horowitz. Learn more about compliance re-engineered for the age of AI at complyadvantage.com.
descriptions.job-163wj5v:
Associate Director/Senior Manager - Leadership Hiring

The CoinDCX Journey: Building the Future of Finance

At CoinDCX, our mission is clear - to make crypto and blockchain accessible to every Indian and enable them to participate in the future of finance.

As India's first crypto unicorn valued at $2.45B, we are reshaping the financial ecosystem by building safe, transparent, and scalable products that power adoption at scale.

We believe that change starts together. It begins with bold ideas, relentless execution and people who want to build what's next.

If you're driven by purpose and thrive in environments where your work defines the next chapter of an industry, you'll feel right at home here.

About the Role

The quality of leadership talent determines the trajectory of a company.

We are looking for a Senior Manager / Associate Director - Leadership Hiring to build and scale CoinDCX's leadership talent engine. This role will own hiring across Director, VP, SVP, CXO, and other critical leadership mandates, partnering closely with founders and senior executives to identify, engage, assess, and hire transformational leaders.

This is not a traditional recruiting role. It requires deep talent intelligence, exceptional stakeholder management, strong assessment capabilities, and the ability to influence high-stakes hiring decisions.

What You'll Do

You will lead Leadership Hiring across six strategic pillars.

1. Leadership Talent Acquisition

  • Build leadership teams that accelerate business growth.
  • Own end-to-end hiring for Director, AVP, VP, SVP, CXO, and critical strategic roles.
  • Partner with founders and business leaders to define leadership talent requirements.
  • Develop bespoke search strategies for complex and high-impact mandates.
  • Drive successful closure of business-critical leadership positions.

2. Executive Search & Talent Intelligence

  • Build market conviction before initiating search.
  • Conduct leadership talent mapping across relevant industries and ecosystems.
  • Develop a deep understanding of organizational structures, leadership talent pools, and succession movements.
  • Provide market intelligence on talent availability, compensation, and competitive landscapes.

우리는 누구나 쉽고 편리하게 의료를 접하는 세상을 만듭니다.

닥터나우 프로덕트 팀은,

365일 24시간, 내가 원할 때 언제든 진료를 받을 수 있는 비대면 진료 서비스부터, 내 증상에 대한 다양한 고민을 묻고 해결할 수 있는 실시간 의료 상담까지. 고객이 아플 때 겪는 다양한 문제를 해결하는 서비스를 만들어요. 닥터나우는 모바일 앱 / 웹을 통한 유저향 서비스 뿐만 아니라, 병원과 약국의 진료 및 조제를 도와주는 의사/약사 서비스(B2H/B2P)도 운영하며 의료 전반의 영역에서 혁신을 만들고 있어요.

Product Designer는 이 모든 경험의 중심에서 고객의 문제를 직관적인 흐름과 설득력 있는 UI/UX로 풀어내고, 팀이 올바른 문제를 해결하고 있는지 끊임없이 질문하며 제품의 완성도를 높이는 역할을 수행합니다.
의료 영역에서 생기는 문제를 고객의 목소리를 통해 파악하고, 항상 고객 관점에서 생각하며 다양한 가설을 빠르게 검증해 나가는 분들과 함께하고자 해요. 새로운 시도에 가슴 뛸 준비가 되었다면, 지금 지원해 주세요!

ㅣ 함께 하면 이런 일을 해요

  • 닥터나우 서비스에 대한 깊은 이해도를 바탕으로 프로덕트를 설계하고, UX/UI 디자인을 통해 고객에게 가치를 전달하는 핵심 과정에 깊이 관여하며 최고의 고객 경험을 만들어요.
  • 고객들이 의료 생활 과정에서 겪는 다양한 문제를 발굴하고, 리서치-데이터-가설을 기반으로 문제를 구조화하여 디자인 솔루션으로 풀어내요.
  • PO/개발자/마케팅/CX 등 다양한 직군과의 협업 경험을 바탕으로, 명확한 근거와 논리로 설명하고 합의점을 도출해요.
  • 와이어프레임, 사용자 흐름, 프로토타입, UI 시안 등을 통해 아이디어를 빠르게 검증하고 성공적으로 제품을 출시해요.
  • 출시 이후에도 지표와 사용자 반응을 통해 문제를 재정의하고, 지속적인 개선 사이클을 주도적으로 실행하며 문제를 해결해요.

ㅣ 이런 분을 찾고 있어요

  • 사용자 문제를 관찰하고 Why 중심으로 사고하며, 논리적으로 문제를 정의하고 디자인으로 해결해 본 경험이 있으신 분
  • 사용자 흐름, 정보 구조, 인터랙션에 대한 이해를 바탕으로 완성도 높은 UI/UX를 설계하고, 실험 가설 및 A/B 테스트 설계에 참여해 보신 분
  • 고객 중심으로 사고하며, 정량적-정성적 데이터를 수집하고 해석해 디자인 의사결정에 반영하는 것이 익숙하신 분
  • 디자인 툴(Figma)을 활용해 완결성 있는 디자인 결과물을 만들 수 있는 분
  • 주도적이고 능동적으로 업무를 진행하고, 디자인 결과물에 대한 피드백을 주고 받는 유연한 태도를 가지신 분
  • 복잡한 문제에 대한 도전 정신이 투철하고, 새로운 비즈니스를 탐구하며 더 나은 방식의 도전을 즐기는 분
  • 3년 이상의 모바일 앱/웹 서비스 UX/UI 디자인 경험, 또는 그에 준하는 문제 해결 경험과 포트폴리오를 보유하신 분

ㅣ 이런 경험은 더욱 좋아요

  • 모바일 앱 / 웹 서비스를 기획하고 개발하여, 프로덕트로 비즈니스 성장을 견인하는 과정을 경험해본 분
  • 수요자와 공급자를 연결하는 플랫폼 비즈니스를 경험해 본 분
  • 복잡한 요구사항 속에서 비즈니스 임팩트와 리소스를 고려하여 디자인의 우선순위를 정할 수 있으신 분
  • 주니어 프로덕트 디자이너들의 성장을 서포트하며 디자인 조직의 일하는 방식을 개선해 본 경험이 있는 분
  • 디자인을 결과물이 아닌 '의사결정 과정'으로 인식하고, 팀의 사고 수준을 한 단계 끌어올리는 데 기여하고 싶은 분

ㅣ 포트폴리오는 이렇게 작성해주세요

  • 사용자 중심의 문제 해결 과정이 잘 드러날 수 있도록 작성해주세요.
  • 프로젝트별 역할과 기여도를 꼭 작성해주세요.
  • 정량적/정성적으로 어떤 성과를 만들었는지 알려주시면 더욱 좋아요.
  • 결과물을 잘 확인할 수 있도록 과한 투시의 목업 이미지는 피해주세요.

ㅣ 근무 조건 및 환경

  • 근무형태 : 정규직
  • 근무시간 : 주 5일(월~금), 10:00~19:00 (자율 근무제)
  • 근무지역 : 서울
  • 급여 : 면접 후 결정

ㅣ 전형 절차

서류전형 ▸ 1차면접(실무, 라이브 디자인 테스트 포함) ▸ 2차면접 ▸ 최종합격

라이브 디자인 테스트 안내

descriptions.job-07zm7ur:
We started a movement in which everyone can win – shoppers, retailers, society and every person on our team. To play fair, trust people and reward them for doing the right thing. We see and feel the impact of our work as more and more people gain financial freedom and retailers grow across the globe.

Founded in 2014 in Sydney, Australia, Afterpay has over 24 million active customers globally and more than 250,000 of the best retailers around the world including Anthropologie, Revolve, DSW, GOAT, Finish Line, Levi’s, Mac Cosmetics, Ray-Ban and many others.

Afterpay is helping people spend responsibly! We empower customers to access the things they want and need, while still allowing them to maintain financial wellness and control, by splitting payments in four, for both online and in-store purchases. Afterpay is deeply committed to delivering positive outcomes for customers. Now under the Block ecosystem, we are focused on supporting our community of shoppers.

We trust in the next generation and share a vision of a more accessible and sustainable world in which people are rewarded for doing the right thing.

The Role

The Australia and New Zealand SMB & Franchise Sales team at Afterpay is responsible for driving revenue to our core consumer payments business, giving our Merchant partners access to one of the largest and most engaged networks of next generation consumers.

We are looking for a strategic, analytical, high-energy, and experienced Head of SMB Acquisition Sales to lead and scale a high-velocity, playbook-driven sales engine across a broad and growing base of small and medium-sized businesses, while forging and expanding relationships with fast-growing and established Franchise partners. The SMB segment spans multiple motions, including a BDR function that sources and books meetings for Account Executives, an Inbound motion serving smaller, higher-volume businesses, and an Outbound-led motion focused on larger, higher-growth SMB and Premium SMB segments. The Franchise motion adds a higher-touch, more sophisticated sales environment focused on winning and expanding relationships with leading franchise groups and brands from SMB’s through to Mid and Enterprise size prospects. You will be responsible for orchestrating these motions into a cohesive system and for the discipline, tooling, processes, and deal strategies that help generate pipeline, convert opportunities, onboard merchants efficiently, and win business at scale.

A successful candidate exhibits a strong sense of ownership to win new business for Afterpay and a demonstrated ability to navigate ambiguity; think strategically and operationally about business, marketing, product, and technical challenges; and lead cross-functional workstreams ultimately tied to pipeline creation, conversion, and revenue growth. This role requires a strategic problem solver who is a rigorous operator, relentless negotiator, and effective influencer, comfortable balancing data-driven rigor and scalable sales processes with high-touch relationship building, a strong bias for action, and hands-on execution.

Beyond ultimately being responsible for revenue outcomes across our SMB & Franchise merchant pipeline - spanning a broad range of industries across retail, fashion, beauty, travel, QSR, home and more across Australia and New Zealand - you will also be responsible for building and supporting a strong culture of performance. You will develop leaders and individual contributors, create clarity and accountability across the organization, and lead with empathy without ego.

The ideal candidate has demonstrated excellence in building and operating high-velocity sales motions at scale, navigating complex commercial negotiations, leading and managing high-performing teams, and continuously improving how teams sell, operate, and deliver results.

You Will

  • Oversee the A/NZ SMB & Franchise Sales Team: Lead a multi-motion organization spanning BDR, Inbound and Outbound Account Executives, together with the Franchise sales motion. Build and continuously refine the playbooks, processes and tooling that let the team convert and grow merchants efficiently at high volume while also enabling sophisticated, high-touch Franchise deal execution. Craft a segment-wide strategy and hold the team accountable to delivering on OKRs and revenue targets across each motion, in concert with the broader Sales & Account Management function at Afterpay.
  • Build an A-Team: Inherit and further develop a team of strong performers and leaders with relevant experience. Build their skills, knowledge, efficacy, and an overall culture focused on performance and continuous improvement, including coaching frontline managers to drive results through their own teams. Set an energetic and accountable tone for the A/NZ sales organization, rooted in a strong sense of ownership and led with empathy over ego.
  • Develop Meaningful Cross-Functional Partnerships: Work closely with cross-functional teams to better support your team in generating revenue, including Marketing, Finance, Product, Engineering, Risk, Legal, Account Management, Partnerships and more. Influence without authority across teams and build the internal relationships required to navigate a distributed, global and matrixed set of stakeholders.
  • Own Sales Process and Methodology: Build and refine repeatable sales approaches across the full deal lifecycle - from prospecting, discovery and qualification through articulating value, solutioning, negotiating, contracting, closing and onboarding. Balance standardized, scalable SMB motions with the flexibility and commercial judgment required for more complex Franchise opportunities.
  • Craft Deal Strategy: Develop and pitch powerful sales narratives that educate prospective merchants on Afterpay's value proposition. Coach the team through sophisticated deal negotiations, support internal and external advocacy, clear blockers to revenue, and effectively communicate with senior decision makers at high-growth and established brands and franchise groups.
  • Drive Forecasting Rigor and Pipeline Hygiene: Implement and maintain best practices in forecasting accuracy, pipeline coverage, pipeline health, opportunity progression, and conversion. Partner closely with Finance and Sales Strategy / Operations to ensure forecasts are rigorous, risks and upside are understood, and the organization is focused on the activities and opportunities that will drive outcomes.
  • Define Ideal Customer Profile and Value Proposition: Shape and sharpen our ideal customer profiles, priority use cases, and value propositions across SMB and Franchise. Leverage insights, data and market intelligence to centralize and socialize the sales and growth narratives that resonate most with merchants and inform our broader B2B marketing, product and go-to-market strategy.
  • Drive Portfolio and Segment Strategy: Leverage insights across the team's pipeline and merchant portfolio to identify priority industries, franchise networks, growth opportunities and emerging trends. Translate those insights into clear segment strategies, scalable acquisition motions and commercial priorities across Australia and New Zealand.
  • Be the Voice of Afterpay: Represent the business to SMB and Franchise merchants as a thought leader in payments and Buy Now Pay Later, demonstrating Afterpay's value as a growth driver for small, growing and established businesses. Develop and grow Block's relationships with merchant partners, including senior leadership teams where appropriate.
  • Be the Voice of the Merchant: Represent market feedback and sentiment internally, advocating for merchants while balancing the needs and constraints of our business. Aggregate and deliver key insights across the organization in a structured, consistent and proactive manner to influence product, marketing, risk and commercial priorities.

You Have

  • An obsession with our products and a motivation fueled by feeling the impact of your work as more consumers build financial wellness with Afterpay.
  • 12+ years of experience in high-growth environments leading SMB Sales, Franchise Sales, BDR, Mid-Market Sales, or Account Management organizations, preferably in a fast-moving technology, payments, or financial services company, with experience operating across both high-volume sales motions and complex commercial relationships.
  • Excellent leadership skills with the ability to develop talent, motivate high-performing teams, and build strong cross-functional relationships, including a proven track record of coaching and managing frontline managers to results. You put your people in the best position to succeed, and your management style is tailored to each individual to maximize their performance and engagement at work.
  • Experience standing up, scaling, or transforming sales organizations - hiring, onboarding and developing talent across BDRs, AEs, and frontline managers, and designing the structures and operating rhythms required to support growth.
  • Demonstrated ability to build, operate, and continuously improve playbooks that scale across a large and growing team while preserving the judgment and flexibility required for sophisticated deals.
  • A demonstrated track record of leading teams that consistently drive revenue growth and exceed their revenue targets, including experience with sophisticated commercial negotiations and established clients.
  • Proven experience navigating and operating effectively within matrixed global organizations and aligning regional priorities with broader global strategies.
  • Experience working closely with Product and Marketing to drive conversion, including improving merchant acquisition, sign-up, activation and onboarding journeys, and translating merchant needs into product and go-to-market opportunities.
  • A high familiarity and comfort with how product development works, preferably in payments. You can hold your own with stakeholders across technical, marketing, product and commercial disciplines and have credibility with Product and Engineering partners.
  • Strong executive presence, with demonstrated ability to influence and earn trust with senior internal leaders and external decision makers, ask the right questions, and use sound business judgment, including with C-suite stakeholders at larger merchant and franchise partners.
  • An operational mindset as well as a strategic one - you can set a clear vision, implement robust processes, lead teams through complex relationships, and translate strategy into disciplined execution.
  • Comfort working with analytics and tools that support business performance measurement and management, particularly forecasting, funnel, pipeline, conversion, productivity and revenue metrics at scale.
  • Creative storytelling abilities, with the ability to seek out relevant, meaningful data and build compelling business cases and sales narratives that demonstrate Afterpay's value proposition.
  • A scrappy and humble mindset, where toggling between team lead and in-the-weeds work is business as usual. You're equally comfortable writing an annual plan as you are jumping into a pipeline review, supporting a complex negotiation, or unblocking a team member. You get the job done and inspire others to do so as well.

Application Guidelines

Candidates may submit up to 9 active applications within a 60-day period. Reapplications to the same role are accepted 90 days after a previous application has been reviewed.

Use of AI in Our Hiring Process

We may use automated AI tools to evaluate job applications for efficiency and consistency. These tools comply with local regulations, including bias audits, and we handle all personal data in accordance with state and local privacy laws. 

Contact us here with hiring practice or data usage questions.

Every benefit we offer is designed with one goal: empowering you to do the best work of your career while building the life you want. Remote work, medical insurance, flexible time off, retirement savings plans, and modern family planning are just some of our offering. Check out our other benefits at Block.

Block, Inc. (NYSE: XYZ) builds technology to increase access to the global economy. Each of our brands unlocks different aspects of the economy for more people. Square makes commerce and financial services accessible to sellers. Cash App is the easy way to spend, send, and store money. Afterpay is transforming the way customers manage their spending over time. TIDAL is a music platform that empowers artists to thrive as entrepreneurs. Bitkey is a simple self-custody wallet built for bitcoin. Proto is a suite of bitcoin mining products and services. Together, we’re helping build a financial system that is open to everyone.

descriptions.job-13ctcn7:
Building the Future of Open Finance

Payward - the parent company behind Kraken, NinjaTrader, Breakout, xStocks, Payward Services and CF Benchmarks - has spent the last 15 years building one of the most modern and globally accessible financial infrastructure platforms in the industry, built to advance an open, global financial system.


Before you apply, we encourage you to explore our culture page to understand what drives us and how we work.

The team

We are seeking a seasoned Senior Risk Manager with 10+ years of risk management experience at a CFTC-registered Derivatives Clearing Organization (DCO) to join our risk function. This individual will play a critical role in safeguarding the integrity of our clearinghouse by leading the design, calibration, and ongoing oversight of margin models, stress testing frameworks, and broader market risk methodologies. The successful candidate will work cross-functionally with clearing operations, technology, compliance, and senior leadership to ensure that the DCO’s risk management framework meets the highest regulatory and industry standards. Prior experience at a Futures Commission Merchant (FCM) is strongly preferred and will bring valuable perspective on the participant side of cleared markets.

The opportunity

  • Margin Modeling & Methodology

    • Ongoing performance monitoring of initial and variation margin models across cleared products, including futures, options, and swaps.

    • Lead periodic recalibration of margin parameters (lookback windows, volatility scaling, anti-procyclicality measures, liquidity add-ons, concentration charges) and document changes in accordance with the DCO’s model governance framework.

    • Evaluate and enhance portfolio-based margining methodologies (e.g., SPAN-style, VaR/Expected Shortfall, filtered historical simulation) for accuracy, defensibility, and regulatory compliance.

    • Conduct back-testing, sensitivity analysis, and model performance reviews; clearly articulate findings to internal stakeholders, the Risk Committee, and regulators.

    Market Risk & Stress Testing

    • Design, execute, and continuously refine the DCO’s stress testing program, including historical, hypothetical, and reverse stress scenarios.

    • Monitor market risk exposures of clearing members and the clearinghouse as a whole, including concentration, wrong-way risk, liquidity risk, and tail-risk exposures.

    • Assess the adequacy of the default waterfall, guaranty fund sizing, and skin-in-the-game contributions in light of evolving market conditions.

    • Produce daily, weekly, and monthly risk reporting to senior management, the Risk Committee, and external regulators.

    Regulatory & Governance

    • Ensure ongoing compliance with CFTC Part 39 DCO Core Principles, including those governing financial resources, margin, risk management, default procedures, and system safeguards.

    • Serve as a liaison to the CFTC and other regulators during examinations, rule certifications, and ad hoc inquiries.

    • Maintain robust model risk management documentation aligned with industry standards and the DCO’s internal governance policies.

    • Support the Chief Risk Officer in Risk Committee preparation, member due diligence, and the evaluation of new products and clearing services.

    Clearing Member Oversight

    • Conduct financial and operational risk reviews of clearing members, including assessment of capital adequacy, liquidity, and risk management practices.

    • Monitor intraday and end-of-day exposures, margin calls, and collateral sufficiency; escalate emerging risks to the CRO and senior leadership.

    • Partner with operations and technology to enhance real-time risk monitoring tools and dashboards.

What you bring

  • Minimum of 10 years of risk management experience at a CFTC-registered DCO, with direct ownership of margin and/or stress testing methodologies.

  • Deep, practical knowledge of CFTC regulations, particularly Part 39 DCO Core Principles, and familiarity with adjacent rules under Parts 1, 22, and 190.

  • Demonstrated expertise in market risk concepts: VaR, Expected Shortfall, scenario analysis, volatility modeling, and portfolio risk aggregation across futures and options.

  • Foundation in margin model design and validation (SPAN, SPAN 2, historical simulation, parametric, or Monte Carlo-based approaches).

  • Hands-on experience designing and executing stress testing programs that meet DCO regulatory expectations (liquidity stress, default management drills).

  • Bachelor’s degree required in a quantitative discipline (Finance, Economics, Mathematics, Statistics, Engineering, or related field); advanced degree (Master’s) preferred.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with proven ability to present complex risk concepts to executives, board members, and regulators.

  • Sound judgment under pressure, with the ability to make defensible risk decisions in volatile markets.

  • Intellectual rigor and attention to detail in model design, validation, and documentation.

  • Collaborative orientation across risk, operations, technology, compliance, and legal functions.

Institutional Fabric for the Digital Asset Market

Founded in 2018, Talos provides institutional-grade trading technology for the global digital asset market, powering many of the major players in the crypto ecosystem. Our mission is clear: to advance the mass adoption of digital assets by seamlessly connecting institutions to the digital asset ecosystem. We are committed to building the most innovative and trusted platform in the world, supporting the entire trading lifecycle.

At Talos, you’ll find an environment that champions kindness and respect, values diverse perspectives, and upholds inclusivity at every turn. We believe every member of our team brings invaluable insights and abilities that drive Talos forward. In our pursuit of excellence, we foster a culture of trust, integrity, collaboration, and mutual growth.

We are a tight-knit yet globally distributed team of highly experienced engineers and business leaders, with hubs in New York, London, Singapore, and Cyprus. You’ll be part of a hybrid-friendly environment where your unique talents and insights will play a crucial role in building something extraordinary.

 

Strategic Account Manager

We are seeking a Strategic Account Manager to own Talos's most consequential client relationships across large asset managers, hedge funds, retail brokers, institutional brokers, and global banks.

These institutions are at a technology inflection point. Their existing OMS, EMS, and custody infrastructure was built for traditional asset classes, not 24/7 digital markets. They are deciding right now which technology partners will take them forward, and most of those decisions will be made before a formal process begins. The mandate of this role is to get ahead of those decisions: understand what each client is trying to build, shape how they think about the problem, and make Talos the obvious answer before alternatives are seriously evaluated.

This is a high-agency individual contributor role. You will own the outcome for your accounts without a team beneath you and without formal authority over the internal stakeholders you need to move. You will partner closely with the Global Head of Revenue and Global Head of Account Management, and work in a matrix relationship with Product, Business Development, and Executive leadership.

 

Responsibilities

Strategic account ownership

  • Own a defined book of Talos's largest strategic accounts across asset managers, hedge funds, institutional and retail brokers, and global banks.

  • Build and maintain a rolling 12-month account plan for each account: stakeholder map, current product footprint, white space, active client initiatives, and a prioritized expansion thesis.

  • Get ahead of client technology decisions including OMS evaluations, custody transitions, and settlement or clearing infrastructure upgrades.

  • Know each client's organization well enough to identify which business units are about to prioritize a digital asset initiative.

Relationship and stakeholder development

  • Build relationships across each account at multiple levels: trading desks, technology, operations, finance, risk, and the C-suite.

  • Identify and develop executive sponsors in business units where Talos does not yet have active engagement. This means initiating conversations, not waiting for introductions.

  • Run structured discovery engagements: map the client's end-to-end workflow, identify operational bottlenecks, and translate those findings into documented product opportunities.

Expansion and growth

  • Identify expansion opportunities across additional product lines, new business units, and adjacent workflows before clients raise them.

  • Qualify tokenization and digital asset initiatives by separating genuine demand from exploratory interest, and build a business case for Talos's involvement before engaging the product team.

  • Prioritize your expansion pipeline. When product resources are constrained, make a reasoned case for which opportunity should move first and why.

  • Drive net-new opportunities surfaced within strategic accounts through the commercial process. Establish clear ownership and maintain client momentum to close.

Product strategy input

  • Serve as the primary connection between strategic client requirements and Talos's product organization. Client problems you surface should become documented product inputs.

  • Evaluate whether a client problem is specific to that account or indicative of a broader market need, and build a structured case before bringing it to the product team.

  • Represent client requirements in internal product discussions with the specificity needed to act on them: current workflow, scale of impact, and competitive risk if left unaddressed.

Cross-functional execution

  • Align Sales, BD, Product, and Executive stakeholders around strategic account opportunities. You will not have organizational authority over any of them. You will need to build the case, create the urgency, and hold people accountable to commitments.

  • Set the agenda for strategic engagements, QBRs, and executive briefings. Prepare the internal team, own what gets communicated, and follow through on every commitment made in the room.

  • Maintain accurate account records in Salesforce: contact roles, account plans, open opportunities, activity history, and health status. Clean records are a prerequisite for cross-functional coordination at this account size.

  • Bring competitive intelligence from client conversations into Talos's GTM and product strategy.

Qualifications

Required

  • 7 or more years of experience in strategic account management, enterprise sales, or client coverage at a market technology vendor, financial institution, or institutional digital asset platform.

  • Direct experience working with or selling into asset managers, hedge funds, institutional brokers, or global investment banks on either the buy side or the sell side.

  • Fluency in institutional trading workflows: OMS, EMS, and PMS platforms; order management and execution; allocations, settlement, and post-trade processes. You can map a client's front-to-back trade lifecycle without asking them to explain it.

  • Demonstrated ability to navigate complex organizations and build relationships at multiple levels simultaneously, without relying on formal introductions or organizational authority to open doors.

  • A track record of identifying expansion opportunities within existing accounts and converting them to commercial outcomes, including cases where you initiated the conversation before the client had a defined need.

  • Operates with high agency. Identifies what needs to happen, builds the internal alignment to make it happen, and drives it to completion without waiting to be directed.

  • Clear executive communication. Can turn a complex client workflow or strategic opportunity into a specific, evidence-based case for clients and internal stakeholders.

Highly valued

  • A background managing strategic relationships at an institutional digital asset firm, covering large asset managers, prime brokers, retail brokers, or global banks.

  • Experience holding roles both inside a financial institution and at a technology vendor. Understanding the operating model from both sides is a meaningful advantage in this role.

  • Understanding of how tokenization and digital asset adoption will affect settlement, custody, and fund operations at large institutions. Deep crypto knowledge is not required, but deep market structure knowledge is.

  • Familiarity with Salesforce for account management, pipeline tracking, and activity logging.

  • Website: Explore Talos: Products, Investors, Team & More

  • Culture: Award-winning, Forbes-listed, low-attrition team

Benefits

You will also enjoy a comprehensive array of competitive benefits, regardless of your location, within our warm, welcoming, and ambitious company culture. Some of our benefits include:

  • Retirement plan contributions

  • Unlimited Vacation + a PTO bonus: Employees that take 15 days of vacation, with 5 days being consecutive, receive a $2000 USD bonus.

descriptions.job-1pjioxv:
The role:

You’ll be a senior engineer on the UniFi stack, working across both its offchain infrastructure and onchain components.

You do not need prior experience with this exact stack. We hire for distributed-systems depth and proven ability to ramp fast on unfamiliar deep tech. If you’ve spent years in Ethereum L2s or L1 clients, wonderful, but the bar is ramp speed, not resume keywords. If your background is trading systems, consensus, or low-latency backend infrastructure and you can learn the Ethereum-specific parts quickly, we want to talk.

What you’ll build and own:

  • The Engine (Rust): L2 and L1 preconfs (preconfirmations), parallel block building, and blocksapce configuration.
  • Cross-chain settlement paths: vault contracts custodying capital on Ethereum L1, execution on the L2, and relayer services with confirmed-send semantics, serialized nonce management, and crash-restart recovery.
  • On-chain infrastructure: Rollup Contracts and messaging between L1 and L2.
  • Off-chain services in TypeScript (Node 20, viem): high-cadence pricers signing EIP-712 payloads, cross-chain relayers, risk monitors, keepers, and quoting bots, engineered for restarts, nonce races, and stale-data edges.
  • TEE attestation infrastructure: hardware attestation verification (Intel TDX DCAP, AMD SEV-SNP) implemented in both Solidity and Rust, kept in lockstep by cross-language parity tests.
  • ZK Proofs: Zero knowledge proofs
  • The test surface that keeps it honest: Foundry fuzz and invariant suites, adversarial regression tests, and live-testnet E2E harnesses.

You’ll pick a primary layer; you’re expected to read across all of them.

How we work:

  • Security is built into the process: External audits, invariant gates in CI, and honest internal tracking of what’s production-grade versus simulated.
  • Ship to a live network: We deploy continuously. Your work can be running in production within days, not quarters, and is read by client-team and rollup-stack peers, not just your standup.
  • Small, senior team: Direct ownership, written decision-making (ADRs), and minimal process overhead.

What we offer:

  • Competitive compensation: Salary + token/equity.

Remote-friendly: Work from where you’re most effective, with flexibility across time zones.

  • Meaningful ownership: Join a small, senior team where your work directly shapes the product, architecture, and network.
  • High-impact work: Build infrastructure that ships to a live network and is used in production, not prototypes that sit on a roadmap.
  • Room to grow: Take ownership beyond your initial scope as the team and network scale.
  • Low bureaucracy: Direct access to the team, fast decisions, and minimal organizational overhead.

How to apply:

Email unifi@puffer.fi with:

  • Your GitHub username and the hardest system you’ve built, a repo, design doc, or postmortem; and
  • 3–5 sentences on the nastiest failure mode you’ve personally debugged in a distributed system.

We read code before CVs. We reply to every application that includes both. But do include your resume as a PDF. No cover letter needed. Our docs are public at http://docs.puffer.fi. We’d rather you read them and show up skeptical than judge us by this posting.

About Puffer & Puffer UniFi

Puffer builds Ethereum-native infrastructure: the pufETH liquid restaking protocol, the UniFi based rollup, and the UniFi Preconf. UniFi is an OP-Stack rollup sequenced by Ethereum’s own validators, pairing L1-grade neutrality with real-time UX: sub-10ms execution preconfirmations backed by restaked ETH, ~10-second withdrawals via a TEE multi-prover (Intel TDX + AMD SEV) instead of a 7-day dispute window, and same-slot L1⇔L2 composability through the Signal Service. Sequencing value flows back to Ethereum, not to us.

We’re backed by Brevan Howard Digital, Electric Capital, Coinbase Ventures, Yzi Labs, Kraken Ventures, Franklin Templeton, and F-Prime (Fidelity), plus grants from the Ethereum Foundation and EigenLayer.

What we’re looking for (must-haves):

  • Excellent general software engineering: 5+ years (or equivalent evidence) building production systems other people depended on. You write code reviewers trust and tests that catch real bugs.
  • Strong distributed-systems fundamentals: You reason natively about ordering, idempotency, at-least-once vs. exactly-once, partial failure, retries, and recovery. You can walk us through a system you built where one of these was the hard part we will ask, in detail.
  • Proven fast ramp on unfamiliar deep tech: Point to a time you went from zero to shipping in a domain with a real learning curve: a consensus client, a database engine, a compiler, a codec. The domain matters less than the slope.
  • Expert in at least one of TypeScript, Rust, or Solidity, and no allergy to the other two. We cross all three daily.
  • An invariant-first testing mindset. You think in properties (“total balances are conserved”) rather than examples, even if you’ve never used Foundry.

We deliberately kept this list short. If you match it, apply, even if you’ve never touched a rollup.

Nice to have:

  • Ethereum L2 development or L1 client development (geth, reth, nethermind, lighthouse, prysm, op-node), explicitly welcomed, explicitly not required.
  • Foundry depth: fuzzing, invariant testing, EVM security instincts.
  • Applied cryptography: typed-data signing systems, commitment schemes, or MPC.
  • Confidential computing exposure: TDX or SEV-SNP attestation, remote-attestation flows.
  • Matching engines, margin/liquidation systems, market microstructure, or other low-latency financial systems.
  • Experience operating many-process service fleets against live networks.
  • Flexible working hours to support a globally distributed team.

Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone’s reach while doing the most important work of your career.

What you’ll do

Stripe is growing its Enterprise sales team in Mexico City. As an Account Executive, you will own a blended, full-lifecycle sales motion: building new strategic relationships while expanding Stripe’s impact within existing enterprise accounts.

You will lead complex opportunities from prospecting and discovery through business-case development, solution design, commercial negotiation, close, and long-term account growth. This role requires the ability to earn credibility with executive, technical, product, risk, and commercial stakeholders, while bringing together Stripe partners across Sales, Solutions Architecture, and other cross-functional teams.

This is an opportunity to help deepen Stripe’s enterprise presence in Mexico, with an expected focus on retail and other strategic businesses. You will be a consultative partner to customers, helping them solve complex business and technical problems with Stripe’s payments and financial-infrastructure platform.

Responsibilities

  • Own the full sales cycle for a portfolio of strategic enterprise prospects and customers—from prospecting and discovery through negotiation, close, and ongoing account development.
  • Develop and execute long-term territory and account strategies that create new business and expand Stripe’s footprint within existing customers.
  • Build strong relationships with executive stakeholders and develop a deep understanding of their business, technical, and payments priorities.
  • Identify, qualify, and develop new enterprise opportunities; create compelling business cases that connect customer needs to Stripe’s products and capabilities.
  • Partner closely with Solutions Architecture, Product, Risk, Legal, and other internal teams to align on customer requirements and deliver thoughtful solutions.
  • Navigate complex buying processes involving multiple technical, commercial, product, and executive stakeholders.
  • Lead deal strategy, commercial structuring, and negotiations for sophisticated enterprise agreements.
  • Maintain rigorous account plans, stakeholder maps, pipeline discipline, and forecasting.
  • Contribute to the development of Stripe’s sales process, customer strategy, and growing sales culture in Mexico.

Who you are

We’re looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Minimum requirements

  • 7+ years of quota-carrying B2B sales experience, with a track record of strong performance in complex sales environments.
  • Experience owning end-to-end sales cycles, including prospecting, discovery, business-case development, negotiation, and close.
  • Demonstrated ability to sell complex products or solutions to enterprise customers and navigate multi-stakeholder buying processes.
  • Experience developing account and territory plans, building executive relationships, and identifying expansion opportunities.
  • Ability to understand technical requirements and translate them into clear customer value.
  • Strong commercial judgment and experience supporting or leading complex negotiations.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills in Spanish and English.
  • Strong presentation and stakeholder-management skills, including in-person and virtual meetings with senior audiences.
  • A collaborative approach and the ability to work effectively with a wide range of internal and external partners.
  • Comfort operating in an ambiguous, fast-paced environment and helping build a growing market.
  • Strong interest in technology, payments, financial infrastructure, or complex enterprise software.

Preferred qualifications

  • Experience selling payments, fintech, technical SaaS, cloud or data infrastructure, developer tools, or related enterprise technology.
  • Experience selling into retail, e-commerce, marketplaces, or other complex digital businesses.
  • Experience managing both new-logo acquisition and expansion within existing enterprise accounts.
  • Familiarity with Mexico’s payments or broader financial-services ecosystem.

This role is based in Mexico City, Mexico and will be operating on a hybrid in-office schedule. (3 days per week).

About the Opportunity

MoonPay is strengthening its control environment as part of its long-term strategy to build a robust, scalable, and compliant platform at the intersection of financial services and digital assets. We are hiring a Chief Control Officer to build and lead a strong first-line risk and control framework across relevant areas of our business.

This is an opportunity for an experienced financial services controls leader to build and scale a control environment in a fast-evolving industry. You will be responsible for ensuring that risks are effectively identified, appropriate controls are designed and implemented, and their effectiveness is continuously monitored as MoonPay grows.

The role will have a particular focus on fiduciary, custody, and regulated financial services activities, requiring significant experience operating within the US banking environment and a strong working knowledge of applicable regulatory and supervisory expectations.

You will work closely with business leaders and with Risk, Compliance, Legal, Internal Audit, and other control functions to establish clear accountability, strengthen first-line ownership, and build a control environment capable of supporting an increasingly complex financial services business.

What You Will Do

  • Build and own the first-line risk and control framework across relevant MoonPay activities, including risk and control assessments, control standards, documentation, governance, issue management, and ongoing monitoring of control effectiveness.

  • Embed effective controls into business processes, translating regulatory requirements, policies, identified risks, and supervisory expectations into practical and sustainable controls with clear ownership and accountability.

  • Establish a robust control monitoring and testing program, identifying control weaknesses, assessing their impact, driving remediation, and providing clear reporting on the effectiveness of the control environment.

  • Develop the control framework supporting fiduciary, custody, and other regulated financial services activities, ensuring appropriate governance, processes, controls, and monitoring are embedded throughout the relevant business activities.

  • Partner effectively across the three lines of defence, working with business leaders and independent Risk, Compliance, Legal, and Internal Audit teams to establish clear roles, effective challenge, timely remediation, and strong first-line ownership.

  • Build for scale and increasing complexity, establishing the procedures, governance, reporting, systems, and operating cadence required to maintain a robust control environment as MoonPay evolves.

About You

  • You bring 15+ years of relevant experience within US banking or regulated financial services, including significant leadership experience in first-line risk, business controls, operational risk, or a comparable control function.

  • You have a proven track record as a builder and operator, with hands-on experience designing, implementing, and improving first-line control frameworks spanning risk assessments, control design, monitoring and testing, issue management, remediation, and governance.

  • You have deep working knowledge of US banking regulation and supervisory expectations, with meaningful experience supporting fiduciary, trust, custody, transaction services, or closely related banking activities.

  • You have a strong understanding of the three lines of defence model and experience establishing effective first-line ownership while partnering closely with Risk, Compliance, Legal, Internal Audit, and senior business stakeholders.

  • You are comfortable operating in a high-ambiguity, fast-scaling environment, combining strong technical judgement with the ability to influence senior stakeholders and personally drive the development of robust control infrastructure from the ground up.

Salary: 330,000 - 400,000 USD
Salary is based on experience and location in the US

Since we opened our doors in 2009, the world of commerce has evolved immensely, and so has Square. After enabling anyone to take payments and never miss a sale, we saw sellers stymied by disparate, outmoded products and tools that wouldn’t work together.

So we expanded into software and started building integrated, omnichannel solutions – to help sellers sell online, manage inventory, offer buy now, pay later functionality, book appointments, engage loyal buyers, and hire and pay staff. Across it all, we’ve embedded financial services tools at the point of sale, so merchants can access a business loan and manage their cash flow in one place. Afterpay furthers our goal to provide omnichannel tools that unlock meaningful value and growth, enabling sellers to capture the next generation shopper, increase order sizes, and compete at a larger scale.

Today, we are a partner to sellers of all sizes – large, enterprise-scale businesses with complex operations, sellers just starting, as well as merchants who began selling with Square and have grown larger over time. As our sellers grow, so do our solutions. There is a massive opportunity in front of us. We’re building a significant, meaningful, and lasting business, and we are helping sellers worldwide do the same.

The Role

We’re building a team of elite sales leaders who raise the performance of everyone around them.

As a Sales Manager, you'll lead a team of approximately 8 Account Executives while owning one of our most important growth levers: developing talent that consistently outperforms expectations. This role isn't about managing activity, it's about building a high-performance sales organization where every hire strengthens the team, every coaching conversation improves execution, and every business decision is grounded in data.

You'll be expected to coach in the work, not after it. You'll diagnose pipeline health before it becomes a forecasting problem, develop future leaders before promotions become necessary, and create an operating rhythm that enables predictable, repeatable growth.

You'll partner cross-functionally to improve how we sell, challenge the status quo, and continuously raise the talent bar across the organization. Success is measured not only by quota attainment, but by the strength of your team, the quality of your pipeline, and the leaders you develop.

  • Build a High-Performance Team

  • Coach Through Data & Business Intelligence
    • Lead your business through rigorous pipeline inspection, forecasting and performance diagnostics. 
    • Use leading indicators to identify performance gaps early and coach reps toward sustainable improvement. 
    • Turn data into action by identifying trends, diagnosing root causes and driving measurable improvements across your team. 
  • Driver Operational Excellence 
    • Establish predictable operating rhythms around forecasting, pipeline management and business reviews. 
    • Build disciplined education that creates consistent, repeatable revenue outcomes. 
    • Continuously improve how your team sells by refining processes, simplifying execution and eliminating friction.

    • Partner closing with sales Leadership, Marketing, Enablement, Operations and Product to improve the customer journey and strengthen commercial execution. 
    • Use customer insights and field intelligence to shape strategy and influence product evolution. 
    • Lead through change by helping your team adapt quickly while maintaining high performance. 

You Have

  • 3 years of documented sales success as an individual contributor exceeding target. 
  • A proven track record leading high-performing sales teams in a fast-paced, high-growth environment.
  • Success developing Account Executives into top performers through structured coaching and clear performance expectations.
  • Deep expertise in pipeline management, forecasting, and using data to improve business outcomes.
  • Demonstrated experience hiring exceptional talent and building teams that consistently outperform.

About Ramp

Ramp is building the smart infrastructure for finance teams, embedded in the transaction flow of every dollar a business spends. We automate how over $200B in annualized spend flows in and out of 70,000+ companies: authorizing payments, flagging risk, categorizing spend, and closing books.

The problems are high-stakes, data-dense, and unforgiving.

We hire people with high agency and high urgency. We look for slope over intercept. We care less about where you trained and more about what you’ve built. At Ramp, everyone is a builder who owns problems end to end and makes consequential decisions that shape the outcome.

The median Ramp customer saves 5% and grows revenue 16% in their first year – far in excess of businesses operating without Ramp. We believe every ambitious company deserves the same.

If you want to build systems that directly shape how companies move and manage billions, Ramp is the place to do it.

About the Role

As the founding Channel Partner Manager for Canada, you will build the partner motion that helps Canadian businesses discover, evaluate, and adopt Ramp through trusted advisors and ecosystem partners.

This is a zero-to-one role. You will own the full partner lifecycle, from identifying and engaging Canadian accounting, advisory, private equity, and venture capital partners through signing, enablement, activation, and partner-sourced pipeline. Your early results will help determine how Ramp scales its Canadian channel motion.

You will work closely with Sales, Growth, Product, Engineering, and the broader Partnerships organization. The right person is a hands-on builder: equally comfortable opening a new relationship, running a partner meeting, solving an operational blocker, and turning early learnings into a repeatable playbook.

What You’ll Do

  • Build Ramp’s Canadian channel strategy and operating rhythm from the ground up.

  • Research, identify, source, qualify and sign net-new Canadian partners.

  • Create joint go-to-market and activation plans to grow the Canadian partner ecosystem.

  • Drive revenue for Ramp through generating referrals

  • Develop trusted relationships with decision-makers and operators inside partner orgs

  • Educate partners on Ramp’s Canadian capabilities, value prop and updates.

  • Own partner onboarding, activation, pipeline generation, and regular business reviews.

  • Work closely with the Canadian Sales team to advance partner-referred opportunities.

  • Partner with Product to surface recurring partner needs and inform the Canadian roadmap.

What You’ll Need

  • 5+ years of relevant experience, including 3+ years in partner sales, business development, channel partnerships, or a closely related role

  • High agency, urgency, and resilience

  • Proven track record of sourcing and managing partnerships

  • Self-starter mindset: you are comfortable getting in the weeds

  • Strong discovery and consultative-selling skills

  • Excellent written and verbal communication

  • Strong operating discipline and comfort using data to improve performance.

  • Proven ability to succeed in a fast-paced environment

  • Strong cross-functional judgment and a history of finding success across cross-functional work

  • Familiarity with the Canadian business and technology ecosystem

  • Strong comfort using AI tools to execute quality work, fast

  • Ability to travel to in-person events in Canada frequently

Nice to Have

  • Experience building a new partner motion, market, or vertical from an early stage.

  • Professional proficiency or native-level fluency in French

  • Presence in the Canadian accounting, advisory, private equity, venture capital, financial-services, or technology partner network

  • Familiarity with finance & accounting workflows and solutions

Benefits available to all full-time Ramp employees (Global)

  • Flexible PTO

  • Centralized home-office equipment ordering

  • Health and wellness stipend

  • Budget for intra-office travel

  • Weekly coffee stipend
